title: 💰 Microsoft launches "Copilot for Finance" — AI that handles accountants' routine work!
body: 💰 Microsoft launches "Copilot for Finance" — AI that handles accountants' routine work!
Microsoft revealed on Thursday, November 19, a new AI tool called "Copilot for Finance", aimed at accountants and finance specialists inside companies.

The tool is not a brand-new model from scratch; it is built on the current "Microsoft 365 Copilot" package, with new features tailored to financial operations such as accounting, cost analysis and managing enterprise resource planning systems.

The goal is for the assistant to take over the boring, repetitive daily tasks that consume finance specialists' time, so they can focus on the important decisions instead of entering data and tracking spreadsheets.
The tool is currently available in "public preview", meaning companies can try it and give feedback before its final launch.

Simply put: imagine a smart accountant working with you all day, checking the numbers, preparing reports and alerting you to errors, while you focus on the decision. That is what "Copilot for Finance" promises.
Do you trust an AI assistant to handle your company's numbers and accounts?
